findings.issue: `IsSemisimplePoint.zpow` repeats verbatim the `cases n with | ofNat … | negSucc …` proof of `GeneralLinearGroup.IsSemisimple.zpow` added in this PR, instead of transporting it as the neighbouring `.pow`, `.inv`, `.mul_of_commute` do.

summary: The new predicate and closure API are not duplicated in Mathlib or TauCeti, but five proofs re-derive material that located lemmas or sibling declarations already provide: the adjoin-unit proof re-does the internals of the Artinian lemma it calls, two coercion blocks re-derive `pointsAction_toLinearMap` and each other, the Tannakian component extraction clones PointFaithful's plumbing (already factored in the monoidal case as `scalarExtensionComponent`), and the point-level `zpow` copies the general-linear-group proof added in the same PR.
